preconditions.description: The length of the string s (m) must be at least 1 and at most n, and n must not exceed 100,000.
The difference between n and m must not exceed 2,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == m and all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length of m and consist only of '(' and ')' characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid pairs of strings p and q modulo 10^9 + 7.
